_readme: Hand-picked images that beat everything else: checked before the cache and
before any live Wikipedia lookup, and never overwritten by a regeneration.
Use this when an automatic pick is wrong. Filename scoring cannot tell a life
restoration from a diagram of an animal's tail muscles, so a handful of taxa
1. Open the animal's Wikipedia page and find an image you want.
2. Click it, then 'More details' to reach its Commons file page.
3. Right-click the picture, 'Copy image address'. That is imageUrl.
4. The Commons page address is fileUrl, and the Author field is artist.
Key must be the SCIENTIFIC name exactly as it appears in the database.
Delete this _readme entry at any time; the game ignores keys it never asks for.
